metadata.title: Sovereign Military P2P Communications Platform - System Security Plan (SSP)
metadata.remarks: SELF-AUTHORED SSP DRAFT for AO package assembly (not accredited; no AO action). Control coverage below is the implemented-boundary subset (12 controls); full High-baseline extension is tracked in the SAR POA&M.

roles.title: Authorizing Official (AO)
roles.description: Designated Senior Defense Official with authority to grant formal Authority to Operate (ATO).

roles.title: Information System Security Officer (ISSO)
roles.description: Responsible for continuous monitoring and post-quantum cryptographic policy enforcement.

roles.title: Key Custodian / Cryptographic Officer
roles.description: Two-Person Rule / Dual Custody custodian for root ceremonies and M-of-N key recovery.

import-profile.remarks: No external profile imported (a prior draft cited a non-existent NIST URL; removed). Tailoring: CNSA 2.0 strict (ML-KEM-1024 + ML-DSA-87 mandatory; see cnsa2_policy_engine.py).

system-characteristics.description: Quantum-resistant, zero-trust, peer-to-peer tactical communications platform utilizing native FIPS 203/204/205 primitives, hardware TPM 2.0 PCR attestation, and WireGuard-style Rust UDP data plane.

information-types.title: National Security Communications (NC3 & Defense Mesh)
information-types.description: Tactical voice, text, telemetry, and critical command authentication data.

status.remarks: Self-assessed development state; operational use requires AO authorization (not granted).

authorization-boundary.description: Encompasses local node memory, physical TPM 2.0 chip, native destroyer_core Rust execution boundary, and WireGuard UDP data plane sockets.

components.title: Post-Quantum Cryptographic Engine (liboqs + destroyer_core)
components.purpose: Provides quantum-resistant key encapsulation and digital signatures.

components.title: Hardware Root of Trust (Win32 TBS / TPM 2.0)
components.description: Physical AMD PSP / Intel PTT TPM 2.0 providing PCR 0/1/2/7 measurement quotes.
components.purpose: Protects root keys and provides remote platform attestation.

components.title: WireGuard-Style Rust UDP Data Plane
components.description: High-throughput asynchronous UDP transport with ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD and fixed quantum framing.
components.purpose: Eliminates side-channel size leakage and provides silent-drop black-hole discipline.

components.title: Tamper-Evident SIEM Audit Engine
components.description: Generates forward-secure HMAC-SHA384 chained audit trails streamed over TLS 1.3.
components.purpose: Supports forensic log integrity and anti-tamper detection (design goal, not a guarantee).

control-implementation.description: Implemented-boundary control subset mapped to NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 (12 controls with in-repo evidence). NOT full High-baseline coverage; extension tracked in SAR POA&M.

implemented-requirements.description: Access Enforcement: Strict Zero-Trust RBAC engine enforces least privilege and default-deny.

by-components.description: Constant-time RBAC role evaluation; unauthenticated actions abort session fail-closed.

implemented-requirements.description: Information Flow Enforcement: Enforces discrete traffic quantum shape and chaff absorption.

by-components.description: All messages padded to 256/512/1232B quanta. Datagrams exceeding 1280B IPv6 MTU silently dropped.

implemented-requirements.description: Event Logging: All authentication, key rotation, and packet drop events recorded.

by-components.description: Structured JSON logging with sequence numbers, UTC timestamps, and cryptographic fingerprints.

implemented-requirements.description: Protection of Audit Information: Audit logs protected via forward-secure HMAC-SHA384 chaining.

by-components.description: Each log entry incorporates the HMAC of the preceding entry. Modifying any log breaks chain verification.

implemented-requirements.description: Non-Repudiation: Every session transaction and certificate signed with ML-DSA-87.

by-components.description: FIPS 204 ML-DSA-87 digital signatures provide non-repudiable proof of sender identity.

implemented-requirements.description: Identification and Authentication: Multi-factor and hardware-backed peer authentication.

by-components.description: Remote attestation verifies genuine physical TPM 2.0 PCR registers (PCR 0, 1, 2, 7).

implemented-requirements.description: Authenticator Management: Post-quantum Double Ratchet provides forward secrecy and break-in recovery.

by-components.description: KEM ratchets advance keys every turn; root keys zeroized on drop.

implemented-requirements.description: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity: Dual-layer authenticated encryption over wire.

by-components.description: ChaCha20-Poly1305 native outer envelope wrapping inner Double Ratchet ciphertext.

implemented-requirements.description: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management: Post-quantum hybrid KEM and M-of-N Shamir backup.

by-components.description: ML-KEM-1024 (FIPS 203) with HKDF-SHA384 domain separation and dual-custody recovery ceremonies.

implemented-requirements.description: Cryptographic Protection: NIST Level 5+ algorithms conforming strictly to NSA CNSA 2.0.

by-components.description: AES-256-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305, ML-KEM-1024, ML-DSA-87, SLH-DSA-256f. Zero legacy ciphers permitted.

implemented-requirements.description: Information System Monitoring: Anti-replay sliding window and token-bucket flood prevention.

by-components.description: 64-bit sliding window bitmap rejects packet replays; token-bucket limits bursts to 64 datagrams.

implemented-requirements.description: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity: CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM and TUF anti-rollback.

by-components.description: Cryptographic bill of materials and software binaries signed with ML-DSA-87.
